q1_issues.issue: (Source sk_die_1 sars) uses the whence-role for 'died FROM SARS', which names a cause and does not answer 'whence'; the mechanical rule is to decide by the question the PP answers, giving the preposition-named oblique instead.
The same causal participant is encoded two different ways in one sentence — Source for 'from SARS' and Instrument for 'with the virus' — so the two clauses' records do not unify.
'the virus' is resolved anaphorically to sars but the class the text supplies for that referent is dropped: no (Member sars virus) atom is emitted.
The two sealed Implication distribution rules inherit the wrapper's (STV 1.0 0.99) where a distribution rule is specified at confidence 0.9.

q2_gaps: 'N more X' — an additive / incremental count relative to a prior running total ('nine MORE people had died', '160 MORE were infected'); Cardinality records a plain group size and there is no carrier for the additive presupposition, so 'more' is dropped with nothing recording it

a truth value for a conjunct inside a seal — the embedded distribution rules cannot carry their own confidence, the same structural limitation already registered for a negated conjunct inside a sealed complement

a country name used metonymically as the holder of a reported attitude ('China said') — the impersonal-reported-attitude section covers an unstated holder, not a named institution standing for its officials
notes: The counted-plural handling is otherwise per spec — group plus Cardinality plus the group event plus a per-member rule for the distributive predicates — and the past perfect correctly takes no Before atom because it sits inside a seal with nothing to order against.
